lead_headline: Restaurant tracker flags 6 new leads—Sifted DEN opens Montbello production kitchen, Dairy Queen-to-Blazing Bird swap confirmed—as subscriber net rebounds to +2 after Thursday's 5-cancellation shedding

restaurant.blurb: 6 new leads today (3 openings, 3 closures) lift active inventory to 85 cases (43 openings, 42 closures)—Friday's batch closes week at 22 opening leads vs 8 closure leads. Openings: Sifted DEN kitchen launches Montbello production facility (confidence 8, corporate caterer's established since 2014); El Sotol Cocina Bar replaces Dos Patrias at 6801 Lowell Westminster (confidence 8, Mexican-Cuban fusion); recategorized legacy entries pad count. Closures: Dairy Queen at 7960 Sheridan definitively confirmed shuttered, replaced by Blazing Bird Nashville hot chicken (confidence 9, third DQ closure this week across Westminster-Littleton-Fort Logan). Week's pattern: opening leads cluster downtown/Union Station corridor (G-Que BBQ, C Burger, Ogo Sushi, Mendocino Farms) while closure leads concentrate chain/franchise casualties—DQ trio, Einstein Bros, CPK Cherry Creek all multi-year tenants.

foreclosure.blurb: 48 filings this week surge 37% from prior week's 35 with zero $2M+ properties—top case caps at $1.1M Douglas County (14247 Beebalm Loop) as 95 auctions queue next 7 days.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications today—April 4 extends statewide filing blackout to 35 consecutive days, now 192% beyond December 2024's 12-day record. Database-lag theory calcifies: no social chatter, no regulatory announcements, suggesting 70-90 application backlog awaiting system restoration. Monday's reading will mark fifth straight zero—if confirmed, escalation to Liquor Enforcement Division mandatory as 12,326-case archive shows no precedent for 5-week void during non-holiday periods. Alternative hypothesis: regulatory freeze pending legislative action, though no bills surfaced in statehouse tracking.

reputation.blurb: 8 mentions yesterday push weekly total to 59 citations (+4% vs prior week's 57)—Friday's haul spans Instagram Larimer Square reshare, Denver Post OpenSnow ski-tech feature, Facebook Continental Theater historical thread. Instagram dominates weekly sources (17 mentions) edging Denver Post (13) and Facebook (10), maintaining social platform command at 49% weekly share (Instagram/Facebook/X combined). Week's spread: 16 unique sources vs prior week's 14, suggesting broader pickup. Rolling 30-day average steadies at 55 mentions/week as April's first four days track 3.7/day vs March's 3.2 opening pace—seasonal uptick or noise pending next week's confirmation.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +2 yesterday (2 new, 0 canceled) bounces back from Thursday's 5-cancel bloodbath—MTD ticks to −1 (−0.3/day) as 90-day net holds +136. Four-day April start: +3 net (13 new, 10 canceled, 0.8 net/day) vs March's opening quartet (+12 net, 3.0/day), confirming 73% acquisition slowdown. Past 7 days post +5 net (19 new, 14 canceled, 58% retention) vs prior week's +22 (29 new, 7 canceled, 81% retention)—churn spike persists as Friday's zero-cancel relief suggests stabilization pending. Longer view: YTD +130 (+1.4/day) still cushions MTD's stumble, but April needs +31 net by month-end to match Q1's 1.4/day pace—current 0.8/day trajectory delivers +20 if sustained, creating 11-subscriber Q1-to-Q2 deceleration gap.
